name: oort
description: Oort memory for Codex: recalls relevant facts before each prompt and adds the Oort memory tools and skill.

interface.longDescription: Oort is open-source long-term memory for AI agents. This plugin recalls relevant facts before each prompt and adds the Oort memory tools (recall, remember, forget, pin, explain and more) and the oort-memory skill. Memories stay on your machine unless you choose Oort Cloud. Needs the oort command: npm install -g oortmem, then oort setup.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about this project last time?
Remember that we deploy on Fridays.
